text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa and I are on our way
back from a
day out, when...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Do you remember Ellie
Condra?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Her farewell match is coming up soon. If
it's okay
with you, I'd like to go
together.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'll explain why she's giving
up at the
match.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I gotta be ready to accept her reason,
no matter
what!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the match, which turns out
to be
just as exciting as the previous
one. It ends with
Ellie Condra as the
victor.

text_block_list.name: Ellie Condra
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone, for coming today
and for
supporting me all this time! I
know this is very
sudden and comes as a
surprise...

text_block_list.name: Ellie Condra
text_block_list.text: But, I...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So she's going back home for her family.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
With her mother sick, it must be a super,
super
difficult time for them...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But still, Ellie Condra...

text_block_list.name: Ellie Condra
text_block_list.text:
This is how I take responsibility! I can't
keep
everyone just waiting for me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ellie Condra...

text_block_list.name: Ellie Condra
text_block_list.text:
I really didn't plan on explaining why I'm
leaving. I
was worried it would hurt my
mother.

text_block_list.name: Ellie Condra
text_block_list.text:
But this way, I can let everyone know
something.

text_block_list.name: Ellie Condra
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who supported me, as well as a
certain
girl who challenged me to prove
my strength...

text_block_list.name: Ellie Condra
text_block_list.text:
Know that while I may be retiring, I'm
not giving
up on becoming world
champion! I'll prove it
someday,
somehow!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
She had the same eyes as me when she
said that!
Brave, like the king of the sky
hunting down prey!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
How could I think that she gave up on
her dream?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching her since she made
her debut.
I can't believe I doubted her
for even a second.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you might be right.
choice_data_list: 驚きが先にきたんだよ
choice_data_list_en: Were you seeing yourself in them?
The surprise just hit me first.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I felt like if she quit, maybe I would quit
someday
too. And that got me scared...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd kissed the weak El goodbye
already.
But... I guess not.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's right!
choice_data_list: もう1度お別れしないとな
もう1度お別れしないとね
choice_data_list_en: We'll have to say our goodbyes again, huh.
We'll have to say our goodbyes again, won't we.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You know what? I'm really glad I came
to her
farewell match today!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now I can say farewell to the chicken
inside of me
too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Ellie Condra! I'll be first to prove that
I'm the
strongest in the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And when you come back someday,
you're gonna
regret letting me win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa raises both arms with
new
determination to pursue her dreams.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I was really shocked. I
couldn't think
of anything else...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm always so calm, but I got real heated
this time!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If my parents got sick, I don't think I'd
know what
to do.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I think I would want to go back home.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But... you can't give up on your dreams.
You have
to keep chasing them no
matter what!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's what my papa would say. Plus...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I have a trainer here who believes in me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely prove I'm the strongest in
the world
someday!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa raises both arms with
new
determination to pursue her dreams.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Aha... I'm a fan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've been so obsessed with
her!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll have fans who are
obsessed with
me someday too.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... That's right!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I promise I won't make you
worry
again!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm the world's strongest, and I'll never
give up on
my dreams!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa raises both arms with
new
determination to pursue her dreams.
